title: EnvelopeFollower, soft-knee gain, transient/sustain separation
description:
Implement the level detector ballistics, soft-knee gain target function, and dual-envelope transient/sustain separation used by per-band dynamic EQ.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §4.2–4.4 (envelope alphas, L[n] in dB, F_K(u), downward/upward g_target, e_f/e_s separation)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §21.3 (dynamic EQ verification notes)
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h if present (public shapes only; do not edit)
- Sibling DSP style under Source/DSP/ from phase B (read only)

Implement Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.h and Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.cpp:
1. EnvelopeFollower class: prepare(sampleRate), reset(), setAttackMs/setReleaseMs (or setTimeConstants), processSample(|x| or sample) updating internal e[n] with attack/release ballistics:
   e[n] = alpha_a * e[n-1] + (1-alpha_a)*|x| when rising;
   e[n] = alpha_r * e[n-1] + (1-alpha_r)*|x| when falling;
   alpha = exp(-1 / (fs * tau)). Expose levelLinear() and levelDb() with L = 20*log10(e+epsilon).
2. Soft-knee helper (free function or nested type SoftKneeGain / computeSoftKneeGainDb): u = L - T; F_K(u) piecewise as spec §4.3 for knee width K; downward compression g_target = -min(D_max, (1-1/R)*F_K(u)); upward action reverses sign and caps by positive range. Optional independent gain-smoothing coefficient separate from detector attack/release (no chatter).
3. TransientSustainSeparator (or dual-envelope API on the same module): maintain e_f (fast) and e_s (slow); transient = max(0, e_f - k*e_s); sustain = max(0, e_s - lambda*transient); expose setters for fast/slow times and k, lambda.
4. No heap allocation in per-sample paths. No JUCE buffer ownership required; plain float sample API is preferred so DynamicProcessor can wrap it.
5. Keep headers self-contained enough for unit tests without plugin deps beyond juce_core/juce_audio_basics if needed.

Do NOT implement DynamicProcessor modes, ParametricBand wiring, CMakeLists.txt, or tests.
acceptance_criteria: EnvelopeFollower implements attack/release ballistics with alpha = exp(-1/(fs*tau)) and exposes linear and dB level
Soft-knee gain computation implements F_K(u) and downward g_target = -min(D_max, (1-1/R)*F_K(u)) per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md section 4.3
Transient/sustain separation exposes dual envelopes with transient=max(0,e_f-k*e_s) and sustain=max(0,e_s-lambda*transient)
No heap allocation in per-sample process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: place soft-knee and transient/sustain helpers in EnvelopeFollower module
float sample API rather than juce::AudioBuffer ownership
independent gain smoother coeff distinct from detector alphas
forbidden: implement detector bandpass filter bank (belongs in DynamicProcessor)
